items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you know, John Lawler told me a lot of boxers used to hang out by the, uh, Big 25.

ctx.x: They can't go around like they'd buy all these old cheap hats and these doors, uh, uh, John B. Stutson.
Well, you know, John Lawler told me a lot of boxers used to hang out by the, uh, Big 25.

Yeah. That was good. See, trying a long, long time ago, that's where they used to have all them big coach games, around 25. Frank Keelan was a trumpet player. He used to gamble at 25. And they had a big guy called Zack, Big, Big Zack, big black fella. Him and Frank Keelan got in a humbug, caught Frank messing around with a deck of cards,
